def test_select_words():

    assert select_words("Mary had a little lamb", 4) == ["little"]
    assert select_words("Mary had a little lamb", 3) == ["Mary", "lamb"]
    assert select_words("simple white space", 2) == []
    assert select_words("Hello World", 4) == ["World"]
    assert select_words("Uncle sam", 3) == ["Uncle"]

    # Empty string
    assert select_words("", 3) == []
    assert select_words("", 0) == []

    # Single word matches / non-matches
    assert select_words("hello", 3) == ["hello"]
    assert select_words("hello", 4) == []
    assert select_words("world", 4) == ["world"]

    # Vowel detection is case-insensitive (uppercase vowels not counted)
    assert select_words("Apple", 3) == ["Apple"]
    assert select_words("APPLE", 3) == ["APPLE"]
    assert select_words("bAnAnA", 3) == ["bAnAnA"]

    # 'y' is not in the vowel list, so it counts as a consonant
    assert select_words("yummy", 4) == ["yummy"]
    assert select_words("sky", 3) == ["sky"]

    # n = 0 matches words with no consonants
    assert select_words("a e i o u", 0) == ["a", "e", "i", "o", "u"]

    # No matches when n is larger than any word's consonant count
    assert select_words("cat dog fish", 10) == []

    # Multiple matches preserve original order
    assert select_words("test best", 3) == ["test", "best"]
    assert select_words("string", 5) == ["string"]
    assert select_words("string", 3) == []

    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
